senses.definition: n.pr.m. priest of On, Joseph’s father-in-law (Egyptian Pʾ-diʾ-pʾ-Rʿ, i.e. he whom the Ra gave, v. SetheDe aleph prosthetico in ling. aeg. (1892), 31; Dr in HastingsDB);—Gn 41:45, 50 (E), 46:20 (P), Πετεφρης, A Πετρεφης.
